risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, particularly regarding assets, deposits, PPP lending, liquidity, and borrowing capacity. Risk tone is moderately cautious due to COVID-19, interest-rate pressure, loan-modification uncertainty, and reliance on assumptions, but there is no overt crisis language. Dense regulatory and program-related detail, along with standard disclaimers, increases complexity and modestly limits clarity.
